master: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE finished primary horizontal logo asset for DivX, a Solana product that separates stock exposure from dividend rights. Exact wordmark: "DivX" (capital D, lowercase i and v, capital X). Brand direction: confident financial editorial design, exceptionally clean flat vector-like geometry, restrained and memorable, generous clear space. Follow the established DivX system: cobalt #2457F5 for stock exposure, amber #C46A00 for dividend rights, dark ink #101820 for lettering. Develop the existing paired-diamond concept into an original compact mark: two offset, complementary softened angular paper-like facets, cobalt left and amber right, with an intentional narrow diagonal negative-space separation. They should read as one recognizable emblem splitting into two parts, with subtle X-like negative space, not a chart. Strong silhouette readable as a favicon; very few edges; no thin interior detail. To its right set DivX in a tightly kerned, heavy modern neo-grotesk sans similar to Inter ExtraBold, visually balanced with the icon. Warm, confident, precise fintech identity. Single mark and wordmark only, horizontally aligned. Optically center the lockup, with compact useful transparent margins, not an oversized presentation board. A wide canvas roughly 3:1 is ideal. Truly transparent background with alpha, clean antialiased edges. No checkerboard baked into pixels. No tagline, labels, color chips, UI screenshot, sheet of variants, extra letters, embossing, mockup, paper texture, shadows, gradients, glow, glossy 3D, coins, rockets, plant motifs, arrows, upward chart, issuer logos, competitor logos, or trademark symbols. This is the master asset that subsequent matching variants will use.
refinement: Use case: precise-object-edit / logo-brand. Refine the supplied DivX logo into the final master. Keep the exact wordmark text 'DivX', its strong heavy neo-grotesk proportions, horizontal layout, and overall size. Change the emblem so it contains EXACTLY TWO connected solid pieces: ONE cobalt shape on the left and ONE amber shape on the right. Remove the detached third amber triangular shard at the bottom entirely. The remaining two shapes should feel like paired softly rounded diamond facets, separated by a clear diagonal gap. Preserve the visual family of the current emblem; do not add a new motif. Crucially, every shape and letter must have an absolutely uniform flat solid fill: cobalt #2457F5, amber #C46A00, lettering #101820. Remove all gradients, texture, speckles, glow, outlines, rim pixels and shading. Clean precise vector-like edges with smooth antialiasing. Same truly transparent background with alpha and wide horizontal canvas. One logo only, no labels, no mockup, no extra text. This output is the canonical master for a consistent logo kit.
